integrity: The proof is an explicit weighted border-polynomial differentiation and an algebraic-unit obstruction. Numeric examples are ancillary, and all source dates and priority claims are qualified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to single forbidden binary words with at least two copies of each digit and no more than two unbalanced borders; does not settle the case of three or more imbalanced borders or the separate stopping-time statistic.
title: Two-imbalance rigidity for unbiased single-pattern shifts
